stories.title: Hawaii: Sturmböe fegt Ironman Caspar Stornes beim Training vom Rad

en.title: Hawaii: Storm gust sweeps Ironman Caspar Stornes off bike during training
en.summary: Ironman world champion Casper Stornes sustained injuries in a training fall and will not defend his title this year, planning to return in 2027.

stories.title: Paula Löber: Die neue Deutsche Weinkönigin kommt aus Sachsen-Anhalt

en.title: Paula Löber: The new German Wine Queen comes from Saxony-Anhalt
en.summary: Paula Löber from Saxony-Anhalt was selected as the 78th German Wine Queen, prevailing against four competitors in the final. She received the crown from her predecessor Anna Zenz.

stories.title: Papstbesuch: Rund 80.000 Menschen feiern Gottesdienst mit Papst Leo in Frankreich

en.title: Papal visit: Around 80,000 people celebrate service with Pope Leo in France
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV held a service at the Stade de France on the first evening of his four-day trip to France, attended by approximately 80,000 young French people.

stories.title: Monarchin auf Zeit: Paula Löber aus Sachsen-Anhalt ist neue Deutsche Weinkönigin

en.title: Monarch for a time: Paula Löber from Saxony-Anhalt is new German Wine Queen
en.summary: Paula Löber from Saxony-Anhalt has been named the new German Wine Queen.

stories.title: Papst IN Frankreich: Leo XIV. feiert Gottesdienst mit 80.000 Menschen im Stade de France

en.title: Pope in France: Leo XIV celebrates service with 80,000 people at Stade de France
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV led an evening service at France's national stadium attended by tens of thousands of young people, during which he encouraged participants to choose what is good.

stories.title: Nach Sturz: Ironman-Weltmeister Stornes verpasst WM auf Hawaii

en.title: After crash: Ironman world champion Stornes misses Hawaii World Championship
en.summary: A cycling crash prevented the Norwegian Ironman world champion from defending his title at the Kona World Championship, though his training partner escaped injury.

stories.title: Regierungsbildung: Linke stimmt für Sondierung mit Grünen und SPD in Berlin

en.title: Government formation: Left party approves preliminary talks with Greens and SPD in Berlin
en.summary: The Left party in Berlin has cleared the path for exploratory coalition negotiations with the Greens and SPD, with a clear majority supporting the proposal.

stories.title: Berlin-Wahl 2026: Linke strebt Sondierungsgespräche mit Grünen und SPD an

en.title: Berlin election 2026: Left party seeks preliminary talks with Greens and SPD
en.summary: Berlin's Left party has invited the Greens and SPD to exploratory coalition negotiations, though whether these three parties will ultimately form a government remains uncertain.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: Bill Gates warnt vor einer Milliarde Todesfällen durch KI

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: Bill Gates warns of a billion deaths through AI
en.summary: Bill Gates has joined technology industry figures warning about existential risks posed by artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Newsblog zu KI: Gates: KI könnte Tod einer Milliarde Menschen verursachen

en.title: News blog on AI: Gates: AI could cause death of a billion people
en.summary: Gates stated that AI tools in the hands of people with harmful intentions could be exceptionally dangerous and that legislation is necessary to address these risks.

stories.title: Bill Gates warnt: „Es gab noch nie eine so mächtige Waffe“

en.title: Bill Gates warns: "There has never been such a powerful weapon"
en.summary: Gates cautioned that AI tools wielded by malicious actors could lead to events resulting in a billion deaths, though he noted human extinction would be difficult to achieve.

stories.title: Premier League: Manchester City schuldig in 114 Fällen?

en.title: Premier League: Manchester City guilty in 114 cases?
en.summary: Manchester City is reported to have violated English Premier League financial rules over many years, with commission findings described as substantial by British media.

stories.title: Chemie: BASF arbeitet an Übernahme von Evonik – Aktien reagieren deutlich

en.title: Chemistry: BASF working on takeover of Evonik – stocks react significantly
en.summary: BASF is considering acquiring Evonik in a potential multi-billion euro merger within Germany's chemical industry, with both companies confirming initial discussions.

stories.title: WhatsApp-Nachricht: Bank-Manager fällt auf KI-Fake rein – Betrüger erbeuten 36 Millionen Euro von Intesa-Sanpaolo-Tochter

en.title: WhatsApp message: Bank manager falls for AI fake – fraudsters steal 36 million euros from Intesa Sanpaolo subsidiary
en.summary: The former chairman of Italian bank Fideuram fell victim to an AI-based fraud scheme and transferred 95 million euros from bank assets. Only a portion of the funds were recovered.

stories.title: Parteitag: Nächster Schritt zur Regierung: Linke in Berlin will mit SPD und Grünen verhandeln

en.title: Party Congress: Next step toward government: Left party in Berlin wants to negotiate with SPD and Greens
en.summary: Berlin's Left party decided at its party congress to pursue coalition talks with the SPD and Greens. Whether the party will lead a government depends on the SPD and unresolved controversies.

stories.title: Landtagswahlen: Erfolgreich mit „Erlebnispopulismus“ – warum die AfD mehr Menschen erreicht als die CDU

en.title: State elections: Successful with "experience populism" – why the AfD reaches more people than the CDU
en.summary: The AfD successfully mobilizes voters that other parties have long lost. Experts attribute this to a strategy that extends far beyond social media.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Iran bei Atomprogramm in Verhandlungen offenbar unnachgiebig

en.title: +++ Iran war +++: Iran appears inflexible in nuclear program negotiations
en.summary: Iran reportedly proposed a seven-day plan to end the war. Netanyahu defended military actions in a UN speech, and Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are planning to meet following Houthi attacks.
